target: TSMC monthly consolidated revenue, TWD million, nominal, unaudited issuer series from 2013 onward
scope: Historical revenue nowcasting; not disruption attribution, physical output or chain-wide production loss
informationSet: Prior calendar months only. Retrospective current-month nowcast after preceding-month disclosure, not a forecast issued before target month began. Historical release dates and unrevised vintages are not available in the annual tables.
candidateFamily: Seasonal revenue multiplied by exp(mean(log year-on-year growth over trailing k months))), k in [1,3,6,12]. Select k on selection-period MAE only. No parameter selection on calibration or test errors.
interval: Fixed symmetric log-error radius at ceil((n+1)*0.8) order statistic of 2022-2023 absolute log errors. Target coverage 80%; time-series exchangeability is not assumed or guaranteed.
comparison: Report all baselines. Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of candidate minus each baseline absolute error; block length 3, 5000 resamples, seed 20260907; 90% percentile intervals. Also report each calendar year separately.
policy: Criteria fixed before candidate scoring. Retain failed results; no tuning or selecting test periods after evaluation. A pass supports only this historical target and horizon. Operational and causal validation remain false.
limitations: Retrospective protocol, not an independently preregistered experiment; public outcome tables were accessible and 2013/2024 source tables inspected before protocol recording.
One company, 24 serially dependent test months, not 24 independent disruptions.
Annual tables may contain revisions; historical first-release vintages and exact historical availability are unverified.
Nominal revenue mixes volume, prices, currency, demand and product mix; forecast errors cannot be attributed to disruptions.
Any successful historical test requires prospective monitoring before operational qualification.
